coverage.scope: Saved 2027-2030 annual corpus plus its early-2031 closing charts and exact pair wheels; includes next Aries boundary for comparison. Duplicate UTC/Ascendant wheels deduped.

cross_chart_rule: Each indexed New/Full light tested on the mod-45 dial against Mars/Saturn, Saturn/Pluto, Mars/Uranus, Uranus/Pluto, Saturn/Neptune midpoints from the dated lawful ingress in force. <=0.25 degrees retained for triage; no independent vote or event inference.
method_boundary: Midpoints use 13-point Munkasey field and mundane_dossier.py midpoint/45-degree rule, target Sun/Moon/ASC/MC. Planetary nodes use Swiss osculating geocentric nodes of Jupiter through Pluto and <=2.5-degree current-planet conjunction screen; osculating versus mean remains an unresolved method choice, so hits are provisional. America screens exact major contacts to ten planets, ASC and MC <=1 degree. Derivative houses are interpretive re-centering and are illustrated in prose, not counted as hits. All results are geometry triage, not literal forecasts, lineage, or evidence.
